note: VECTOR: ANTI-GRAVITY RACING (https://wavedash.com/games/vector-anti-gravity-racing) is capture-class: a WebGPU anti-gravity racer on the Wavedash platform, served by a per-build CDN host (mx70fsjxynf8mke9yqthamtfcx8dtssc-<user-hash>-<build-hash>.builds.wavedashcdn.com) behind a platform session (playKey → embed → gameplay JWT). §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — the project publishes no source repository, so the mirror stands. The build is a Vite production bundle: index.html loads the entry chunk assets/index-DphGw8Ou.js (React runtime + React-Aria UI vendors, the app's music/track/ship tables, the bundled three.js WebGPU+TSL engine, the app UI), which pulls game-CsnOSIff.js (race simulation), player-Cd-Kznkt.js (intro/garage), renderer-setup--EktvnNe.js and award-scene-D9Dc5ufv.js (scenery), the vendored three.js loaders HDRLoader-C77IBAVq.js, the app's audio-preparation.worker-CEAJS9BC.js and the Wavedash SDK client shim client-BtP_tmtQ.js. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, applied until a fixed point — the entry chunk needs 2 passes, everything else 1; the recorded pass count is replayed by the audit — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<tag>.pretty.js|css per captured JS/CSS file (repo-root-relative, dirs flattened with __; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<tag>-NN.js of the app-side JS at top-level declaration boundaries, ~250-350 line windows (oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. Vendor rule — wholeFile sections/regions, never sliced: embed.js (the Wavedash platform SDK), sw-embed.js (its embed service worker), assets/HDRLoader-C77IBAVq.js (the vendored three.js HDR loader chunk) and assets/client-BtP_tmtQ.js (the SDK client shim) are third-party runtime; inside the entry chunk two content-anchored wholeFile regions are asserted by guards — the React/React-Aria UI runtime head and the bundled three.js WebGPU+TSL engine region (ending at the app's track-spline builder). The scenery chunks carry bundler-merged three.js/TSL utility code interleaved with app code at minified module boundaries; those files are sliced statement-aligned and their slices are NOT claimed as clean app code — recorded honestly. Machinery/stylesheet rule — assets/index-J7X__Wjw.css and embed.css are wholeFile. Non-standalone parts are skipped sections: each chunk's final pure export {…} table. Payload rule (engine-build precedent): every file under models/, environment/, audio/, ui/ and the fonts are recorded in notRendered with size + sha256 — never prettified, re-encoded or otherwise rewritten. Backend paths fetched at runtime — /vector/preferences-v1.json and /vector/progress-v1.json (Wavedash userfs cloud saves), /auth/token and /auth/refresh (session rotation) — are platform endpoints, not static assets, and are recorded as gaps in _mirror-report.json. Identifiers in src/ are the bundle's own minified names — the identifier-rename campaign (PLAN §5) is recorded as an open task in README.md, not claimed here. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.

renderOptions._default: prettier 3.9.6, module API, default options, formatted to a fixed point (per-file pass count recorded in sources[].prettyPasses; the entry chunk converges on pass 2) — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input
